item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body in [jngl-mein-sakina-rat-gaye.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/7353d419e5a24c52a9be4170348af11e/src/data/lyrics/jngl-mein-sakina-rat-gaye.md) and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. The opening and all seven stanzas align line for line, including repetitions.

Set the direction to `rtl`, added the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read the ambiguous “aawaaaazay ilaaiyya” as `آوازِ الٰہیہ`. `git diff --check` passed.
